_comment: Surplus-vote agreements (הסכמי עודפים) for the election to the 26th Knesset. The deadline to file them with the Central Elections Committee was 16 October 2026; this is the picture reported on that day (Emess, 12:35, and Kikar HaShabbat both list the same five, and no others). The committee had not yet published its official list when this file was written — check it against that list once it is out. Parties are referenced by Party.id. An agreement only takes effect when both sides clear the threshold, which lib/seats.ts enforces.
